node.label: Seizure precipitated by febrile infection
node.definition: Any form of seizure occurring at the time of a fever (temperature at or above 38.0 degrees Celcius) without infection of the central nervous system, and without an alternative cause such as severe metabolic derangement, occurring at any age.

evidence.snippet: New-onset refractory status epilepticus: Seizure precipitated by febrile infection (frequency HP:0040281) [TAS]
Seizure precipitated by febrile infection — Very frequent (99-80%)
